# Image and link source changes must recompute attachment checkbox defaults

Entry 795 calls SetAttachCheckbox after selecting an image file, changing image or link location and initializing link properties. The helper resets only when the input URL or moz-do-not-send value changes. With no explicit attribute it attaches file and data URLs, uses mail.compose.attach_http_images for HTTP images, and otherwise leaves the box unchecked; an explicit attribute overrides the default. DoAttachSourceCheckbox stores the inverse checked state as a string. Manual editor naming and review proposal here: preserve the negative attribute’s meaning, call the shared helper after actual input changes, and document where a shared global comes from. No modal browser regression test was added by this patch.

Scope: compose-attachment-checkbox.
